name: Mending
description: Repairs durability when collecting experience orbs (2 durability per XP point).

name: Unbreaking
description: Gives a chance for durability not to be consumed on use (Level 3 quadruples item lifetime).

name: Fortune
description: Increases block drop rates for ores, crops, and materials (up to 4x drops at Level 3).

name: Silk Touch
description: Causes mined blocks to drop as themselves instead of their usual items (e.g. glass, ice, ore blocks).

name: Sharpness
description: Increases melee damage against all mobs (+3 damage at Level 5).

name: Smite
description: Substantially increases damage against undead mobs (Zombies, Skeletons, Withers, Phantoms).

name: Looting
description: Increases mob drops and rare drop chances from killed monsters.

name: Protection
description: Reduces all damage taken by 4% per level (up to 64% total with a full set of Protection IV).
conflicts: Fire Protection, Blast Protection, Projectile Protection

name: Feather Falling
description: Reduces fall damage by up to 48% at Level 4 and reduces ender pearl damage.

name: Infinity
description: Shooting regular arrows consumes no arrows as long as at least 1 arrow is in the inventory.

name: Riptide
description: Flings the player forward like a human missile when in water or rain.

name: Efficiency
description: Increases mining and block breaking speed dramatically.
